source.name: hyperflux-next
source.rule: A published recipe fetches one signed annotated tag of this repository and verifies it against the project key in assurance/arch-repository.json; a commit reference is for local qualification only.

packaging_license.rule: The generated recipe files are 0BSD so they can move into official Arch packaging unchanged; the packaged software keeps the licenses each output declares.

options_rule: The signed repository ships the same unstripped OpenRGB module and Cargo-stripped binaries without debug packages; link-time optimization stays off because the Cargo and Clang toolchains apply their own profiles.
